abilities.name: Opening Strike
abilities.text: Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 1 Physical Piercing Damage. Surge 2: deal +1 Damage.

abilities.name: Exploit the Opening
abilities.text: Before rolling Opening Strike against a target that is Exposed, Restrained, or has no other ally within 2 units, gain 1 free die for that Action. Add it to the printed roll; no Pool is spent.

system.gmNotes:
Role use. Threaten a compromised or isolated target while other enemies hold attention. No native Reaction; only two Wounds and no Resilience, so it relies on positioning and supporting allies.

Starting Enemy Example (Essence v0.6, Part XIV). Playtest reference; change its fictional presentation freely.
